# Pracovní listy Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Worksheets ("pracovní listy") as a second kind of test: generated by the model as a draft from a topic, a free brief or pasted text, edited in the existing TestBuilder, printed via the same PDF renderer.

**Architecture:** A worksheet is a `tests` row with `kind = 'pracovni_list'` (schema + migration 0001 already on main). New item kinds `text` and `table` carry their shape in `test_items.content` (zod in core); worksheet tasks are `question` items with only a client-provided snapshot. Core gets the schemas, a worksheet prompt + single-ladder generation function, and PDF rendering of the new items; the web gets `/listy` pages, a generate and a regenerate route and a worksheet mode of `TestBuilder`.

**Tech Stack:** pnpm monorepo, Next.js 16 App Router, drizzle + libsql, zod 4, AI SDK (`generateObject` through `objectCall`/`startLadder`), @react-pdf/renderer, vitest, Playwright.

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-30-pracovni-listy-design.md`

## Global Constraints

- UI texts and code comments in Czech; commits in English Conventional Commits ending with `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`.
- Shape of data only from zod in `packages/core/src/schema` — no second definition (web routes reuse the core schemas).
- Templates are data: fun-fact look is a new `TemplateConfig` part with defaults, no new component per template.
- PDF only via `renderTestToBuffer` in core.
- AI numbers only in `AI_SETTINGS.worksheet` (`materialChars`, `textMax`, `minItems`, `maxItems`, …) in `packages/core/src/ai/settings.ts`; prompts only in `packages/core/src/ai/prompts/worksheet.ts`.
- Worksheet ladder created in exactly one place (`packages/core/src/ai/worksheet.ts`), options `{ models?: AiConfig[]; signal?: AbortSignal }` — the coordinator will add `onCall` there. Do not modify `ladder.ts`.
- Every lib query takes `Scope` first; foreign worksheet → `null`/404. Topic must belong to the school (`skola()`).
- `graded` is always `false` for worksheets, enforced on the server on create and save.
- Worksheet items never go to the bank.
- No new migration. Colours only from tokens in `packages/ui/src/styles.css`.
- Without a usable model: generate button hidden with explanation, blank worksheet offered, no "Přegenerovat".
- Never touch `apps/web/local.db` / port 3000; e2e on port 3100 with `e2e.db`.

## Review Focus

1. Re-saving a worksheet whose question item already has a stored snapshot must store the *edited* question from the client, not the old kept snapshot (the písemka rule "keep old snapshot" must not apply) — pinned in Task 5 test.
2. Corrupted `content` JSON (e.g. table rows of wrong length) must not crash loading/printing the whole worksheet; preview shows the item as faulty, PDF skips it — pinned in Task 1 (`parseItemContent`) and Task 5 (loadTestItems) tests.
3. A client that sends `graded: true` for a worksheet (POST and PUT) still gets `graded = false` — Task 5 test.
4. Copying a worksheet (`copyTest`) keeps `kind`, `topicId`, `brief`, `content`, `needsCheck` — otherwise the copy appears in Testy and loses its tables — Task 5 test.
5. A table taller than a page breaks by rows with the header repeated, and the estimate paginates it the same way — Task 3 test (paginate) + visual check of the rendered PDF.

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement** in `schema/test.ts`:

```ts
export const tableItemShapeSchema = z.object({
  caption: z.string().optional(),
  header: z.array(z.string()).min(1).max(TABLE_MAX_COLUMNS),
  rows: z.array(z.array(tableCellSchema)).min(1).max(TABLE_MAX_ROWS),
})
export const tableItemContentSchema = tableItemShapeSchema.superRefine((table, ctx) => {
  if (table.rows.some((row) => row.length !== table.header.length))
    ctx.addIssue({ code: 'custom', message: 'Každý řádek tabulky musí mít tolik buněk, kolik je sloupců.' })
  if (!table.rows.some((row) => row.some((cell) => cell.blank)))
    ctx.addIssue({ code: 'custom', message: 'Tabulka potřebuje aspoň jednu prázdnou buňku k doplnění.' })
})
```
- [ ] **Step 4: Run** tests → PASS; `npx pnpm@11.21.0 exec tsc --noEmit` in core → fix consumers of `Test` (fixtures `makeTest`, `sample.ts`) by adding `kind: 'pisemka', topicId: null, brief: null`.
- [ ] **Step 5: Commit** `feat(core): schemas for worksheet text and table items`

```ts
export interface WorksheetRequest {
  title: string; subjectName: string | null; gradeName: string | null
  materials: string; ownText: string; instructions: string
}
export type WorksheetItemDraft =
  | { kind: 'heading' | 'instruction'; text: string; needsCheck: false }
  | { kind: 'text'; text: string; content: TextItemContent; needsCheck: boolean }
  | { kind: 'table'; content: TableItemContent; needsCheck: boolean }
  | { kind: 'question'; question: QuestionContent; needsCheck: boolean }
export interface WorksheetResult { title: string; items: WorksheetItemDraft[]; dropped: number; models: string[] }
export type WorksheetTarget = { kind: 'heading' | 'instruction' | 'text' | 'fun_fact' | 'table' } | { kind: 'question'; questionType: QuestionType }
export interface WorksheetAiOptions { models?: AiConfig[]; signal?: AbortSignal; callModel?: WorksheetCall }
export function checkWorksheetItems(raw: unknown[], options: { hasSource: boolean }): { items: WorksheetItemDraft[]; dropped: number }
export async function generateWorksheet(request: WorksheetRequest, options?: WorksheetAiOptions): Promise<WorksheetResult>
export async function regenerateWorksheetItem(request: WorksheetRequest, target: WorksheetTarget, existing: string[], options?: WorksheetAiOptions): Promise<WorksheetItemDraft>
export const WORKSHEET_TOO_FEW_MESSAGE: string
```
  Private `callWorksheet(system, prompt, schema, options)` is the only place calling `startLadder`.
